scope: Research registration only; no repository changes, scene browser, test batches, upload or publication. Existing plan48 and sections45/46 were re-inspected to answer the parent’s specific boundary question.
readingRules: 44 is a composite drawing of different construction layers; do not copy its quadrants as literal different ceiling finishes.
43 juxtaposes roof covering and roof framing; upper short-post and purlin axes do not equal floor-column rows.
44 lower-left floor-column omission topology identifies image-bottom as south; 48 image-top is south.
X sign is a symmetric registration convention here, not a newly established east/west orientation.

drawing44Registration.mapping: raw x=(u-960.5)/25.6; raw z=(672.5-v)/25.6. Register these rounded readings to retained R19 station identities, not a new global rescale.
drawing44Registration.allowanceMeaning: Conservative scan/station registration allowance, not current measurement accuracy or a statistical interval.

centralCeiling.heightStatus: Nominal value chosen within independent section45/46 range; not exact original drawing dimension.

possibleNominalVisualSection.status: Engineering simplification inside scan-supported ranges; total timber depth and joints unknown.

majorCeilingBeams.rearZone: Do not carry these six thick beams unchanged from z=3.6 to z=8.2. Drawing44 shows lighter/different framing in that rear strip; retain continuous panel ceiling there and defer detailed secondary framing.

visibleColumnSegments.indices: i=1..8 and k=1..4, excluding existing omitted i=2..7 at k=2
visibleColumnSegments.allowedMeaning: Existing present posts may be visually continued into the opaque high ceiling/beam assembly. Their new rendered top is an occlusion trim, not a surveyed shaft end or actual column head.
retained: column radii/material identity unless independently reviewed

roofVoid.requiredChanges: Remove only the central rectangle from the old y16.17 ceiling and lower horizontal fan y17.50; preserve their outside parts. Keep upper fan and external roof surfaces unchanged.
roofVoid.interpretation: Existing generic roof geometry admits this central ceiling level without moving external roof tiles; implementation must retain actual material-sidedness and verify its cut topology.

boundaryTransition.sourceReading: 45/46 show beam/frame and descending lower-eave roof/rafter transitions at inner lines. Rear inner posts remain exposed; 44 thick boundary lines do not prove continuous vertical enclosure.
boundaryTransition.doNotAdd: A roughly2.46m-high continuous red or painted ring wall solely to conceal the high/low ceiling difference.
boundaryTransition.boundedTreatment: Retain an open frame transition and the inherited peripheral low-ceiling simplification; describe exact transition/framing as incomplete.

sideEnclosureEvidence.plan48: Both sides show two parallel thick enclosure lines: a continuous outer line and an inner line on the approximately±19.9m station with side openings. The inner line is additional enclosure, not evidence to delete/relocate the outer line.
sideEnclosureEvidence.section45: Both inner and outer side wall/member profiles are present at the end section; this does not establish one continuous upper infill height along the complete inner side wall.
sideEnclosureEvidence.permittedConclusion: High-ceiling side boundary aligns with the inner enclosure/column line; exact opening lintels and upper closure remain deferred.
sideEnclosureEvidence.notPermittedConclusion: Do not infer an all-around vertical ring wall, delete the retained outer side walls, or move them inward from this evidence.
